description_en: Queries full column store audit logs by using streaming
description_zh: 流式查询完整列存审计日志
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx query-columnar-log-sse --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --sql SELECT_0_FROM_polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log_LIMIT_100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryColumnarLogSSE

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the request. The value must match the region where the SQLQuery service is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 请求地域 ID，必须与当前 SQLQuery 服务部署地域一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB-X instance whose column store audit logs you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询列存审计日志的 PolarDB-X 实例 ID
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The read-only query statement to execute. Only a single MySQL SELECT statement is supported. The query table must use the fully qualified form polardbx_sls.<table_name>, and only the following tables are allowed: polardbx_sls.polardbx_log (kernel logs), polardbx_sls.slow_detail_log (slow query logs), polardbx_sls.slow_trans_log (slow transaction logs), and polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log (audit logs). Multi-statement queries, write operations, locks, user variables, dynamic placeholders, and reserved hints are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 要执行的只读查询语句。仅支持单条 MySQL SELECT；查询表必须使用 polardbx_sls.<表名> 全限定形式，并且仅限 polardbx_sls.polardbx_log（内核日志）、polardbx_sls.slow_detail_log（慢日志）、polardbx_sls.slow_trans_log（慢事务日志）和 polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log（审计日志）。不支持多语句、写操作、锁、用户变量、动态占位符或保留 Hint
parameters.name: sql

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of result rows to return for this request. Valid values: 1 to 10000. If this parameter is not specified, no additional row limit is applied to the SQL statement submitted by the caller. The result is still subject to the server-side SSE upper limit of 10000 rows and the top-level LIMIT clause in the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求最多返回的结果行数。取值范围为 1～10000；未传时不额外收紧调用方 SQL，仍受服务端 SSE 上限 10000 行和 SQL 顶层 LIMIT 约束
parameters.name: max_result_rows

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authentication principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authentication principal

AuthPrincipalType.description_en:
The identity type used for authentication in the request. Valid values:
SubUser: RAM user.
AssumedRoleUser: RAM role.
Federated: SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh:
请求中用于鉴权的身份类型。具体取值为：
RAM 用户：SubUser
RAM 角色：AssumedRoleUser
SSO 联合身份：Federated

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denial

AppliedOffset.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. The top-level SQL LIMIT offset actually applied by the service. The value is 0 if the SQL statement does not specify an offset
AppliedOffset.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。服务实际应用的顶层 SQL LIMIT 偏移量；SQL 未指定偏移量时为 0

AppliedRowLimit.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. The maximum number of rows actually applied by the service after combining the top-level SQL LIMIT, MaxResultRows, and the current service policy. This value does not include the extra row used to detect HasMore
AppliedRowLimit.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。服务综合 SQL 顶层 LIMIT、MaxResultRows 和当前服务策略后实际应用的最大返回行数，不包含用于探测 HasMore 的额外一行

Code.description_en: The stable error code. This field is returned only when Type is ERROR. Handle errors based on this field instead of relying on the Message text
Code.description_zh: 稳定错误码，仅在 Type 为 ERROR 时返回。调用方应根据该字段处理错误，不要依赖 Message 文本

HasMore.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. Indicates whether the service or API row limit truncated the SQL statement submitted by the caller. A value of false when the SQL statement completes with a smaller LIMIT does not indicate that no more data exists in the underlying table
HasMore.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。表示服务或 API 行数边界是否截断了调用方提交的 SQL；SQL 自身较小的 LIMIT 完整执行时为 false，不代表底层表中没有更多数据

Message.description_en: The error summary. This field is returned only when Type is ERROR
Message.description_zh: 错误摘要，仅在 Type 为 ERROR 时返回

Partial.description_en: Indicates whether at least one RECORD event was sent before the ERROR occurred. A value of true indicates that the results already received by the caller are incomplete and should not be treated as complete query results
Partial.description_zh: 发生 ERROR 前是否已经发送过至少一个 RECORD 事件。true 表示调用方已收到的结果不完整，不应当作完整查询结果使用

QueryElapsedTimeMilliseconds.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. The elapsed time in milliseconds from the start of JDBC statement execution to the completion of reading the last result row or probe row
QueryElapsedTimeMilliseconds.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。从 JDBC 语句开始执行到读取完最后一条返回行或探测行的耗时，单位为毫秒

QueryId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by the service for this JDBC query. All events in the same SSE stream share the same QueryId
QueryId.description_zh: 服务为本次 JDBC 查询生成的唯一标识。同一 SSE 流的所有事件使用相同的 QueryId

Records.description_en: Returned only when Type is RECORD. A batch of query results carried by this event. Each row is a JSON key-value object that maps column names to text values. SQL NULL is encoded as the string null
Records.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 RECORD 时返回。本事件携带的一批查询结果；每行是列名到文本值的 JSON 键值对象，SQL NULL 固定编码为字符串 null

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a single column in the query result. All scalars are returned as strings. SQL NULL is encoded as the string null. An empty string remains an empty string
additionalProperties.description_zh: 查询结果中的单个列值。所有标量均以字符串返回；SQL NULL 固定编码为字符串 null，空字符串保持为空字符串

RecordsSizeBytes.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. The total UTF-8 byte size of all returned row JSON objects. This value does not include arrays, SSE frames, or fixed response fields
RecordsSizeBytes.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。所有已返回行的 JSON 对象 UTF-8 字节数之和，不包含数组、SSE 帧和固定响应字段

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The same ID is used across all stages of the request, including access, authentication, routing, query execution, and all SSE events, to facilitate end-to-end troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。同一请求从接入、鉴权、路由、查询到所有 SSE 事件均使用该 ID，便于全链路排查

Retryable.description_en: Indicates whether the current ERROR is suitable for retry. A value of true indicates that you can retry the request based on the suggestion returned with the error. A value of false indicates that you need to modify the request or contact the service team for troubleshooting
Retryable.description_zh: 当前 ERROR 是否适合重试。true 表示可按错误返回的建议重试；false 表示应先修改请求或由服务端排查

ReturnedRowCount.description_en: Returned only when Type is EOF. The total number of result rows actually returned in this SSE stream
ReturnedRowCount.description_zh: 仅在 Type 为 EOF 时返回。本次 SSE 流实际返回的结果总行数

Sequence.description_en: The sequence number of the RECORD event, starting from 1 and incrementing. This field indicates the event order and does not represent the result row offset
Sequence.description_zh: RECORD 事件的顺序号，从 1 开始递增。该字段表示事件顺序，不表示结果行偏移量

Type.description_en: The SSE event type. RECORD carries a batch of query results. EOF indicates that the query has completed. ERROR indicates that the query ended with an exception
Type.description_zh: SSE 事件类型。RECORD 携带一批查询结果；EOF 表示查询完整结束；ERROR 表示查询异常结束
